hook: Mufti rules crypto impermissible under Shariah

stories.text: Pakistan religious leader rules crypto not Shariah-compliant
stories.summary: Pakistan's crypto regulator faces a deadlock after a Mufti ruled that crypto is impermissible under Shariah law, preventing recognition as property.

stories.text: CLARITY Act enters make-or-break week in Senate July 13
stories.summary: The CLARITY Act faces a critical phase as the U.S. Senate returns on July 13 with a narrow window for crypto regulation.

stories.text: Circle wins OCC bank charter, SWIFT live with 17 banks
stories.summary: Circle secured an OCC bank charter and SWIFT went live with 17 banks as Bitcoin holds $64K and ETF outflows ended.

stories.text: Bitcoin ETFs end eight-week outflow streak with $197M inflow
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $197 million in net inflows last week, breaking an eight-week streak of withdrawals.

stories.text: Ethereum Foundation AI agents find real validator bug in software
stories.summary: The Ethereum Foundation deployed AI agents that discovered a genuine security flaw in the network's validator software, though humans handled the fix.
